targets.rawSql: SELECT r.mode AS configuration, avg(s.cpu_seconds) * 1000 AS cpu_ms FROM resources_summary s JOIN runs r ON r.id=s.run_id WHERE r.suite=${suite:sqlstring} AND r.profile=${profile:sqlstring} AND s.component='backend' GROUP BY r.profile, r.mode ORDER BY r.profile, r.mode

SELECT r.mode AS configuration, avg(s.ram_mean_mib) * 1.048576 AS mean, max(s.ram_peak_mib) * 1.048576 AS peak FROM resources_summary s JOIN runs r ON r.id=s.run_id WHERE r.suite=${suite:sqlstring} AND r.profile=${profile:sqlstring} AND s.component='backend' GROUP BY r.profile, r.mode ORDER BY r.profile, r.mode
SELECT mode AS configuration, avg(rps) AS requests_per_second FROM runs WHERE suite=${suite:sqlstring} AND profile=${profile:sqlstring} GROUP BY profile,mode ORDER BY profile,mode
SELECT mode AS configuration, avg(p95_ms) AS p95 FROM runs WHERE suite=${suite:sqlstring} AND profile=${profile:sqlstring} GROUP BY profile,mode ORDER BY profile,mode

SELECT r.mode || ' · ' || s.component AS configuration, avg(s.cpu_seconds) * 1000 AS cpu_ms FROM resources_summary s JOIN runs r ON r.id=s.run_id WHERE r.suite=${suite:sqlstring} AND r.profile=${profile:sqlstring} AND s.component IN ('monitor','collector') GROUP BY r.profile,r.mode,s.component ORDER BY r.profile,r.mode,s.component

SELECT r.mode || ' · ' || s.component AS configuration, avg(s.ram_mean_mib) * 1.048576 AS mean, max(s.ram_peak_mib) * 1.048576 AS peak FROM resources_summary s JOIN runs r ON r.id=s.run_id WHERE r.suite=${suite:sqlstring} AND r.profile=${profile:sqlstring} AND s.component IN ('monitor','collector') GROUP BY r.profile,r.mode,s.component ORDER BY r.profile,r.mode,s.component
SELECT mode AS configuration, avg(log_bytes) / 1000000.0 AS bytes FROM runs WHERE suite=${suite:sqlstring} AND profile=${profile:sqlstring} GROUP BY profile,mode ORDER BY profile,mode

SELECT mode AS configuration, sum(unexpected_errors)::double precision / NULLIF(sum(requests),0) AS error_rate FROM runs WHERE suite=${suite:sqlstring} AND profile=${profile:sqlstring} GROUP BY profile,mode ORDER BY profile,mode

SELECT r.mode AS configuration, count(*) AS attempts, avg(s.ram_mean_mib) * 1.048576 AS ram_mean_mb, min(s.ram_mean_mib) * 1.048576 AS min_mean_mb, max(s.ram_mean_mib) * 1.048576 AS max_mean_mb, stddev_samp(s.ram_mean_mib) * 1.048576 AS ram_stddev_mb, avg(s.cpu_seconds) * 1000 AS cpu_ms, stddev_samp(s.cpu_seconds) * 1000 AS cpu_stddev_ms FROM resources_summary s JOIN runs r ON r.id=s.run_id WHERE r.suite=${suite:sqlstring} AND r.profile=${profile:sqlstring} AND s.component='backend' GROUP BY r.profile, r.mode ORDER BY r.profile, r.mode

list.name: suite
list.label: Серия
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT suite FROM runs ORDER BY suite DESC

list.name: profile
list.label: Сценарий
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT profile FROM runs WHERE suite=${suite:sqlstring} ORDER BY profile
